changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO jhi_user (login, password_hash, first_name, last_name, email, image_url, activated, lang_key, created_by, created_date, last_modified_by, last_modified_date) SELECT LOWER(email), password, first_name, last_name, email, avatar_url, TRUE, 'fr', 'legacy-import', created_at, 'legacy-import', updated_at FROM users legacy_user WHERE CHAR_LENGTH(email) <= 50 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jhi_user existing_user WHERE LOWER(existing_user.email) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = LOWER(legacy_user.email) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci );
INSERT IGNORE INTO jhi_user_authority (user_id, authority_name) SELECT imported_user.id, CASE WHEN legacy_user.role = 'ADMIN' THEN 'ROLE_ADMIN' ELSE 'ROLE_USER' END FROM users legacy_user JOIN jhi_user imported_user ON LOWER(imported_user.email) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = LOWER(legacy_user.email) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci WHERE imported_user.created_by = 'legacy-import';
